04 / BEFORE YOU DISAPPEAR

GOOD
TO KNOW.

The details, without the noise.

What is AFTERHOURS?+

AFTERHOURS is an independent portfolio concept exploring music, identity, and interactive event design. The venue, artists, and schedule are fictional. There is no real event or ticket sale.

Where does the night take place?+

Our imagined home is The Relay, an industrial venue in Berlin with three distinct spaces: The Core, Static, and Drift. All set times use Berlin summer time (CEST). No real venue or travel booking is associated with this concept.

How do I build my night?+

Tap the + beside an artist to save their set. Open My night to see your choices in time order and spot any overlapping sets. Your selections stay in this browser on this device; clearing browser data removes them.

Can I turn off the motion or sound?+

Sound starts off and only plays after you load a track and press play. Your device’s reduced-motion preference is respected. You can also pause the animation with the motion control in the footer.

What about access and a safer dancefloor?+

The concept is built around readable information, keyboard access, reduced motion, and a quiet-space stage. For a real event, venue access, travel, age restrictions, and welfare arrangements would need to be verified before tickets go on sale.
